For anyone who should not be carrying a full laundry bag down three flights of stairs, Neptune Laundry pickup and delivery removes the lifting entirely. You leave the bag at your door and it comes back folded at your door.

The service runs out of 489 Saratoga Street in East Boston, MA, and covers fourteen cities and towns across Greater Boston and the North Shore. There is no sorting to do, any bag works, and wash dry fold is priced by the pound.

Do you have a parent or a neighbor who has been managing this the hard way? This is the fix. Schedule through the Neptune app on iOS or Android and use code FIRST20 on a first order.
